highlights.title: Edit a task after it is made
highlights.line: On a task page, Edit title or detail changes its words, and the task's activity records what changed and who changed it.

highlights.title: A task can wait for a merge or a time
highlights.line: An agent can set a task to wait for a pull request or branch (with GitHub connected), a file or a time. The task shows what it waits for.

highlights.title: A signed-out agent page says so
highlights.line: An agent page left open while Kosmos restarts or updates says it needs a sign-in, links the steps, and offers no model switch until then.

highlights.title: No model recorded says where to set it
highlights.line: An agent with no model recorded says so, not Unknown Model, and links its AI Settings when Kosmos started it.

highlights.title: A new agent gets a Files folder
highlights.line: A new agent gets its own Files folder from the start, so it has a place to save a file for you the first time you ask.
